latestVersion.changelog:
Indexy 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches API access to Indexy’s cryptocurrency index management platform.
- Enables AI agents to create and update custom crypto indices with flexible weightings and eligibility criteria.
- Provides endpoints for listing and viewing details of agent-owned indices.
- Supports API Key (Bearer token) and Web3 (EIP-191) authentication methods.
- Documents standard rate limits and includes pagination for results.
- Security note: API domain is indexy.co; web app is indexy.xyz – never send API requests to the web app.
